pipeline.title: Fortrea boosts early-phase CRO platform with $45M acquisition of Worldwide division
pipeline.summary: Fortrea has agreed to acquire the early-phase services division of fellow CRO Worldwide Clinical Trials for $45 million.

pipeline.title: UniQure, after setbacks, seeks FDA approval of Huntington’s gene therapy
pipeline.summary: The company is now hoping for an affirmative answer on its application after an unusually turbulent year dealing with U.S. regulators.

pipeline.title: Novartis claims MS win as Rhapsido clears phase 3 with ‘no liver safety signal’
pipeline.summary: Novartis appears to have broken the curse of the BTK inhibitor class. The Swiss pharma announced Tuesday that two phase 3 trials for Rhapsido in relapsing multiple sclerosis hit their goals without any liver safety flags.

pipeline.title: Alumis crushed by midstage lupus flop but plots path to phase 3 for TYK2 inhibitor
pipeline.summary: A phase 2b lupus trial of Alumis’ envudeucitinib has missed its primary and secondary endpoints. But the biotech is still moving the TYK2 inhibitor into phase 3 in the autoimmune disease, pointing to evidence of efficacy in a prespecified subgroup of patients to support its decis

pipeline.title: GSK catches phase 3 fever after mRNA flu vaccine beats standard shots
pipeline.summary: GSK has linked its mRNA seasonal flu vaccine candidate to higher immune responses than conventional jabs in a phase 2 trial, emboldening the company to start a pivotal study this month.

pipeline.title: ESC: Alnylam's next-gen silencer sees silver linings after fallout of AZ, Ionis trial in ATTR-CM
pipeline.summary: As AstraZeneca appears to close the book on a combo approach following the phase 3 failure of its Ionis-partnered Wainua, several analysts contend it’s too early to count out Alnylam’s silencing drugs in ATTR-CM patients also taking standard-of-care stabilizers.

pipeline.title: Electra aims to light up Nasdaq with IPO for phase 2/3 I&I push
pipeline.summary: The 2026 IPO streak continues as Electra Therapeutics has filed to go public to support its immunology and cancer pipeline.

pipeline.title: ESC26: AstraZeneca's heart failure drug shows promise in ph. 2 trial
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca’s oral relaxin agonist delivered encouraging phase 2b results in chronic heart failure, improving measures of cardiac function across two patient groups.

pipeline.title: ESC: AZ, Ionis' Wainua post-mortem throws water on silencer-plus-stabilizer approach in ATTR-CM
pipeline.summary: After a surprise washout in a recent phase 3 trial of AstraZeneca and Ionis’ antisense oligonucleotide Wainua, the likely reason for the miss is being laid bare, in a potential ill omen for others pursuing silencer drugs in transthyretin-mediated amyloid cardiomyopathy.

pipeline.title: BioNTech-Genentech cancer vax records more deaths than control in scrapped ph. 2 test
pipeline.summary: Following Merck and Moderna’s phase 3 triumph with a Keytruda-paired personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, a similar shot from BioNTech and Genentech has faltered in a reminder of the approach’s struggles as a standalone therapy.

pipeline.title: ARPA-H puts up $125M to bankroll personalized RNA-based drug production
pipeline.summary: RNA-based vaccines and therapeutics may have faced a bumpy road in the U.S. recently, but a major new federal investment proves the government is still betting big on its future.

pipeline.title: Novartis telegraphs 130 job cuts amid biologics rethink in Switzerland
pipeline.summary: Novartis could cut about 130 jobs in Switzerland as it rethinks its biologics technical development and production footprint in Basel.

pipeline.title: Autoimmune CAR-T faces tough questions after Novartis, Bristol Myers study halts
pipeline.summary: Wall Street analysts believe that a more cautious approach to manufacturing, study enrollment and side effect management could help developers avoid future safety hazards.

pipeline.title: Teva autoimmune antibody notches ph. 2 win in celiac disease
pipeline.summary: Teva Pharmaceutical's dreams of a first-in-class autoimmune blockbuster are being kept alive after the Israeli outfit’s anti-interleukin-15 antibody scored a midstage win in celiac disease.

pipeline.title: SEC, FDA sign info-sharing agreement as a ‘signal to the market’ on insider trading
pipeline.summary: The SEC and the FDA have signed a three-year agreement to step up cooperation and information-sharing capabilities, aiming to improve each organization’s regulatory and enforcement missions.

pipeline.title: TScan axes 75% of workforce to make room for solid tumor programs
pipeline.summary: TCR-T specialist TScan Therapeutics will reduce its workforce by 75% following the pause of its hematological and autoimmune programs.

pipeline.title: Teva claims success in celiac study; BioMarin, Ascendis settle patent dispute
pipeline.summary: Teva believes the therapy has “pipeline-in-a-product” potential. Elsewhere, a high-stakes trial was paused and GSK advanced a competitor to Moderna’s flu shot.

pipeline.title: Trump GLP-1 update teases blockbuster annual sales for Lilly from Medicare program: analyst
pipeline.summary: As part of the MFN drug pricing deal the Trump administration signed with obesity giants Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk, Medicare recently launched a “bridge” model, offering weight loss drugs to eligible seniors at $50 per month. Now, we know the initial uptake from the program.

pipeline.title: Cellares downsizes New Jersey operations after losing BMS cell therapy contract
pipeline.summary: After losing Bristol Myers Squibb as a client, Cellares continues to move forward with the right-sizing its CEO unveiled late last month.

pipeline.title: Novartis inks $3.2B subcutaneous drug delivery deal with Alteogen
pipeline.summary: Novartis has struck a deal worth up to $3.2 billion to work with Alteogen on subcutaneous drug delivery, joining Biogen and GSK on the list of drugmakers to pay to access the technology this year.

pipeline.title: From his parents’ basement to your medicine cabinet: Absci CEO endeavors to create biotech’s Apple
pipeline.summary: The overwhelming demand for GLP-1 weight loss drugs has reshaped the drug market, empowering consumers to take charge of their own health and removing barriers between their wallets and their medicine cabinets.

pipeline.title: Galderma, Novartis dominated ad space last NFL season with most effective ads: report
pipeline.summary: TV outcomes company EDO determined that Galderma’s skin disease med Nemluvio led the charge with the highest engagement score across all advertisers during the 2025-26 NFL football season.

pipeline.title: Mid-cap biotechs join Trump’s latest round of drug pricing deals
pipeline.summary: Focused on Medicaid, the new pacts now involve more than just large pharmaceutical companies, but still aren’t expected to meaningfully impact drugmaker profits.

pipeline.title: Novartis says MS pill succeeds in two large studies
pipeline.summary: Notably, Novartis revealed that remibrutinib wasn’t associated with the kind of liver-related side effects other BTK inhibitors like it have encountered.

pipeline.title: Rising Stars: Genentech’s Tiffany William brings a 'fail fast, learn fast' marketing mentality
pipeline.summary: After pivoting from mobile gaming marketing to pharma, Genentech performance marketing engagement lead Tiffany William is making performance marketing "less daunting" and "more fun" and approachable.

pipeline.title: Alumis’ TYK2 drug fails in key lupus study
pipeline.summary: Though Alumis still sees a path forward in lupus, the result made its drug the latest TYK2 blocker to struggle in conditions beyond psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis.

pipeline.title: Roche inks $1.53B deal for Simcere’s B-cell-targeting antibody
pipeline.summary: Roche is paying oncology-focused Simcere Zaiming $75 million upfront for global rights to a preclinical trispecific antibody targeting B-cell-mediated diseases.

pipeline.title: ArsenalBio sheds most of staff in pivot to in vivo CAR-T
pipeline.summary: About a year after halving its staff in a clinical push, Arsenal Biosciences is now making a hard pivot that involves laying off most of its employees and seeking out new homes for its assets.

pipeline.title: What’s Next in Immuno-Oncology - A Visionary Conversation with Dr Ira Mellman
pipeline.summary: This podcast feature a fireside chat between Dr Ira Mellman, PICI and Dr Axel Hoos, Former CEO, Scorpion Therapeutics from the 2026 Immuno-Oncology 360° conference.

pipeline.title: Novocure hit by cyberattack exposing patient data
pipeline.summary: Novocure has become the latest medtech company to be hit by a cyberattack, with the oncology specialist revealing that unauthorized access to some of its information systems exposed patient and employee data.

pipeline.title: Bausch + Lomb survey reveals low dry eye awareness for perimenopausal, postmenopausal women
pipeline.summary: A new survey out from Bausch + Lomb has shown that dry eye disease is one of the least recognized symptoms present in perimenopausal and postmenopausal women.

pipeline.title: Medtronic recalls reflux monitoring device as 184 serious injuries linked to capsule
pipeline.summary: Medtronic is recalling certain esophageal pH monitoring capsule delivery devices amid risks of them failing whilst deployed.

pipeline.title: Boston Scientific halts sales of angiographic catheters amid 2 serious injuries
pipeline.summary: Boston Scientific has told its customers to stop using its Imager II angiographic catheters upon learning that a manufacturing issue has impacted the tips of the devices.

pipeline.title: Emergent re-ups Narcan education push across US, Canada on overdose awareness day
pipeline.summary: Emergent BioSolutions looks to expand awareness and education of its Narcan opioid overdose reversal spray with an expanded campaign that kicked off on International Overdose Awareness Day.

pipeline.title: Novartis, Bristol Myers pause autoimmune CAR-T trials due to safety concerns
pipeline.summary: The deaths of three study participants led Novartis to halt development of rap-cel in multiple indications, while “transient” side effects pushed Bristol Myers to voluntarily pause its zola-cel program.

pipeline.title: White House unveils next round of MFN pricing deals with 9 midsized drugmakers
pipeline.summary: Some four months after the White House inked the last of its expected drug pricing deals with 17 of the industry’s top players, the U.S. government is back for round 2, this time lining up agreements with a host of medium-sized biopharmas under President Trump’s ‘most favored nat

pipeline.title: UPDATED: Novartis halts autoimmune CAR-T trials after 3 deaths, as BMS also pauses studies
pipeline.summary: Three deaths have forced Novartis to pause development of its CD19 CAR-T candidate in autoimmune diseases, just as Bristol Myers Squibb has halted a similar program due to immune-related adverse events, Fierce has learned.

pipeline.title: Ascendis to pay 20% Yuviwel royalties in patent settlement with BioMarin
pipeline.summary: BioMarin now collects royalties on the more convenient competitor product. Ascendis will pay 20% of Yuviwel net sales in the U.S. dating back to the first commercial sales and through to May 2030.

pipeline.title: FDA OKs Takeda, Protagonist drug for rare blood cancer
pipeline.summary: The clearance and broader-than-expected label for Mimrylo open up a yearly revenue opportunity for Takeda that some analysts expect to reach $2 billion or more.

pipeline.title: CDMO Lonza hones commercial focus with company vet's return to new role
pipeline.summary: Samanta Cimitan, Ph.D., will serve in a newly created role as the CDMO's chief commercial officer, SVP and member of the extended executive committee starting Jan. 1, 2027.

pipeline.title: Lilly adds to immune drug pipeline with $2.9B Merida buyout
pipeline.summary: The big drugmaker’s latest company acquisition this year is centered around a technology designed to degrade proteins that malfunction in autoimmune disorders.

pipeline.title: ESC ‘26: Cytokinetics’ sell-off, Arrowhead’s edge and a heart drug autopsy
pipeline.summary: At a big meeting for cardiovascular medicines, Cytokinetics and Arrowhead aimed to separate their drugs from competitors while a failed study pressured Alnylam.

pipeline.title: FDA dings Alar over ‘extremely concerning’ ketamine claims
pipeline.summary: The FDA sent Alar Pharmaceuticals an untitled letter after finding fault with the company’s exhibit booth display and brochure at a recent conference.

pipeline.title: Jazz’s Ziihera secures 2nd survival win to solidify its HER2-positive stomach cancer status
pipeline.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals has added a second overall survival win to Ziihera’s cap, bolstering the bispecific’s claim as the new HER2 agent of choice in stomach cancer.

pipeline.title: B. Braun adds to a string of IV solution recalls in US
pipeline.summary: Late August has been rough for IV solution makers as B. Braun added to its recall tally once more, building on Baxter’s three recalls of similar products in the same time frame.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly inks $2.88B Merida buyout for autoimmune drugs against rogue antibodies
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a deal to acquire Merida Biosciences for up to $2.875 billion, establishing a beachhead in efforts to treat disease through the selective degradation of pathogenic autoantibodies.

pipeline.title: Natera teams with Angiex on cancer drug trial monitoring
pipeline.summary: Natera inked a collaboration deal with biotech Angiex to assess the use of its Signatera blood test, which looks for small traces of cancer DNA in patients who have been diagnosed and treated for the disease.

pipeline.title: Takeda bolsters blood cancer portfolio with FDA nod for Mimrylo in polycythemia vera
pipeline.summary: The FDA has approved Takeda’s Mimrylo (rusfertide) for polycythemia vera, introducing a new mechanism to the nonmalignant rare blood cancer and handing CEO Julie Kim another major regulatory win since taking the helm.

pipeline.title: On the 'cusp,' PharmaEssentia gains FDA label expansion for Besremi
pipeline.summary: The FDA has signed off on a label expansion for PharmaEssentia's Besremi, endorsing it as a treatment for the rare bone marrow disorder essential thrombocythemia.

pipeline.title: Why real-world data is becoming a strategic asset in drug development
pipeline.summary: Labcorp's Catie Schlechter discusses how sponsors are using real-world data to improve trial design, recruitment and strategy.

pipeline.title: China in Global Clinical Development: Why Early Inclusion Matters
pipeline.summary: Leading biotechs are rethinking China’s role in global clinical development. Early inclusion can unlock significant value.

pipeline.title: HCP media's endemic-versus-reach debate misses the real question
pipeline.summary: Endemic media and broad reach each do half the job. What makes them work together is not more spend, but a signal that says when.

pipeline.title: Beyond the Bandwidth Ceiling: Redesigning Advanced Therapy Operating Models for the Digital Staff Era
pipeline.summary: Advanced therapy manufacturers are hitting a bandwidth ceiling. Deloitte makes the case for redesigning ops around AI 'digital staff.'

pipeline.title: The Clinician With 2 Million Followers Is Shaping Prescribing Behavior. Pharma Can Now Be Part of That Conversation
pipeline.summary: Millions of HCPs follow digital opinion leaders online. Here's how pharma can find, vet, and support the right ones in 2026.

pipeline.title: Pharma Doesn't Have an AI Problem. It Has an Information Problem.
pipeline.summary: Frontier Large Language Models have improved. More data became accessible. Neither solved the hardest questions. Here's what decision-grade pharma AI still needs.

pipeline.title: ‘A neuroscience revolution’: The GLP-like race to keep us awake and make billions doing it
pipeline.summary: As the hype around the vast medical potential of GLP-1 drugs continues unabated, another peptide is starting to make its own mark.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: Another Tavneos domino falls as UK rescinds authorization
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: TScan telegraphs 75% headcount drop; ArsenalBio winnows down workforce
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.
